description: Inspect tire deformation over a tested 0.25–8 PSI demonstration range and learn pressure for ride height. Preserve 07 limits for calibration/export.

arg_help.target-height: Axle height [m]; null generates a synthetic target inside the numerically checked reachable range.
arg_help.load: Additional spindle load [N]; null uses the vehicle asset's estimated chassis share per wheel.
arg_help.train: Start pressure learning automatically (or fit stiffness with CSV); false starts a manual preview.
arg_help.calibration-csv: Static measurements with explicit nominal pressure, additional load, axle height, uncertainty and train/validation split.
arg_help.export-config: New vehicle_telemetry replay JSON, plus a provenance report; exported after convergence.
arg_help.ground: telemetry keeps 07 contact settings; firm doubles flat contact stiffness and damping. These are compliance experiments, not soil or uneven terrain.
arg_help.pressure-range: null selects tested 0.25–8 PSI for the demonstration, or source 07 limits for CSV/export. Set telemetry explicitly for the original Warthog 2–4 PSI comparison.
